install_msg: Thank you for installing SINWallGuard. Use [p]load sinwallguard, then [p]sinwallguard meme #memes for the recommended meme-channel setup with thread containment. Optional: use [p]sinwallguard logchannel #mod-log to copy deleted wall-text to a moderator channel. Use [p]slash sync after loading if you want slash commands immediately.
name: SINWallGuard
short: SIN Corp wall-of-text containment with optional threads.
description: Per-channel word and character limits with SIN Corp lore warnings, strike tracking, optional short timeouts, optional moderator logging, and optional thread containment for long discussions. Includes hybrid slash/prefix commands.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server channel settings and the configured moderator log channel persistently. It does not persistently store end-user message contents or user strike data inside the cog. If moderator logging is enabled, deleted message text is copied into the configured Discord moderator channel. If thread containment and reposting are enabled, deleted message text is copied into a public Discord thread. Temporary strike counts and active thread tracking are kept in memory and are cleared when the cog unloads or the bot restarts.
